name: Dog Head
source:
"You know that trading in people's lives is a serious thing. If you can't show people you know that, your crew aren't gonna want to put their lives on the line for you."

An officer of the Red Flower Society. He is a militant type who, unlike the other officers, was not afraid to charge into situations alone.

[From [url=http://www.rpgdl.org/rsl/en.html#character]official site[/url]]
